const body = $input.item.json.body || $input.item.json;
return {
  source: 'website_form',
  fullName: body.fullName || 'Anonymous Inquirer',
  email: body.email || 'client@raqba.pk',
  phone: body.phone || '+92 300 0000000',
  buyerSellerType: body.buyerSellerType || 'Buyer',
  budgetMin: Number(body.budgetMin) || (Number(body.budgetMax) ? body.budgetMax * 0.7 : 20000000),
  budgetMax: Number(body.budgetMax) || 45000000,
  financingType: body.financingType || 'Cash',
  targetPropertySlug: body.targetPropertySlug || '1-kanal-spanish-villa-dha-phase-6-lahore',
  timelineMonths: Number(body.timelineMonths) || 1,
  city: body.city || 'Lahore',
  verbatimQuote: body.verbatimQuote || 'Direct inquiry submitted for private walkthrough.',
  dataConsent: body.dataConsent !== false,
  timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
};

const body = $input.item.json.body || $input.item.json;
return {
  source: 'portal_lead',
  portal: body.portal || 'Zameen.com',
  fullName: body.leadName || body.fullName || 'Portal Lead',
  email: body.leadEmail || 'portal.client@raqba.pk',
  phone: body.leadPhone || '+92 300 1122334',
  buyerSellerType: 'Buyer',
  budgetMin: Number(body.priceMin) || 30000000,
  budgetMax: Number(body.priceMax) || 65000000,
  financingType: body.financingType || 'Cash',
  targetPropertySlug: body.listingSlug || '1-kanal-spanish-villa-dha-phase-6-lahore',
  timelineMonths: 2,
  city: body.city || 'Islamabad',
  verbatimQuote: body.message || 'Direct inquiry from Zameen.com/OLX.',
  portalReference: 'PORTAL-' + Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000),
  dataConsent: true,
  timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
};
